coins.name: München

references.shows: our Hamburg coin's back in full colour: copy its colours and finish, not its scene

coins.scene: The Frauenkirche's towers in warm reddish brick with green copper domes; the pretzel golden brown with white salt grains; the diamond ribbon along the front in Bavarian light blue and white diamonds; grass a fresh green.

coins.name: Berlin

references.shows: our Hamburg coin's back in full colour: copy its colours and finish, not its scene

coins.scene: The Brandenburg Gate in warm light sandstone (cream) with a green copper quadriga on top; the TV tower's shaft light grey-white with its ball in silver-white and a red and white antenna tip; the Spree a clear mid blue; the Ampelmännchen bright green; the ground grass a fresh green.

coins.name: Black Forest

references.shows: our Hamburg coin's back in full colour: copy its colours and finish, not its scene

coins.scene: The hills dark fir green, the fir outlines a deeper green; the farmhouse's walls and balcony warm wood brown, its big roof dark brick red-brown, the windows light; the Bollenhut's pompoms bright red on a white hat; the fence wood brown; the meadow a fresh green; the cake slice: dark chocolate brown sponge layers, white cream, one red cherry, the plate white.

coins.name: RheinRuhr

references.shows: our Hamburg coin's back in full colour: copy its colours and finish, not its scene

coins.scene: The Zollverein headframe in its real rusty red steel, the wheels the same red, its base red brick; the crossed hammer and pick: heads dark grey steel, handles warm wood brown; the banner gold yellow with the words GLÜCK AUF in black; the spoil heap's flanks a dark green with the terrace lines and path lighter; the ground grass a fresh green.

coins.name: Niederrhein

references.shows: our Hamburg coin's back in full colour: copy its colours and finish, not its scene

coins.scene: The windmill tower red brick, its cap dark, the sails' lattice wood brown with white sail cloth; the willows' trunks wood brown and their heads a fresh green; the dyke grass a fresh green; the Rhine a clear mid blue; the sheep white with a black face and legs.

coins.name: Nieder-Olm

references.shows: our Hamburg coin's back in full colour: copy its colours and finish, not its scene

coins.scene: The vineyard hill a fresh green with darker green vine rows; the jester's cap in carnival red and yellow, its bells gold, its rim band gold; the grapevine stock wood brown with green leaves and a bunch of purple-blue grapes; the lead rider's small cap red and yellow like the big one; the ground grass a fresh green.

coins.name: Frankfurt

references.shows: our Hamburg coin's back in full colour: copy its colours and finish, not its scene

coins.scene: The skyscrapers in light glass blue-grey with a few in silver-white, the Messeturm's shaft warm reddish with its pyramid top a darker red; the Bembel grey stoneware with cobalt blue painted flowers and leaves; the ribbed glass a pale glass white with a golden apple wine inside; the Römer's gables reddish brick with cream fronts; the Main a clear mid blue; the ground grass a fresh green.

coins.name: Flensburg

references.shows: our Hamburg coin's back in full colour: copy its colours and finish, not its scene

coins.scene: The Nordertor in red brick with its step gable and the dark archway; the lighthouse red and white; the water of the fjord a clear mid blue; the quay a dark grey; the ground grass a fresh green; the rider in the archway black like the other riders.

coins.name: Mecklenburg

references.shows: our Hamburg coin's back in full colour: copy its colours and finish, not its scene

coins.scene: Schwerin Castle's walls in light cream sandstone, its roofs dark slate grey, the big central dome and the turret tips gold; the cranes light grey-white with black neck and wing tips and a small red cap; the lake a clear mid blue; the reeds a darker green; the beach sandy yellow; the beach chair wicker wood brown with a blue and white striped hood; the ground grass a fresh green.

coins.name: 100 Germany

references.shows: our Hamburg coin's back in full colour: copy its colours and finish, not its scene

coins.scene: The number 100: the 1 bold red, the two wheel-zeros black tyres with silver-white spokes; the dashed route red; the meadow a fresh green; everything else as on the Hamburg coin.
